params.prompt: Editorial wellness infographic showing a central icon cluster: a stylized human stomach in the center (anatomical but minimalist line-art style) with small bacteria-shaped icons swirling around it and an indicator arrow pointing downward to a small colon icon below. Above the center reads 'ONE BROKEN PATHWAY' in bold dark navy. Below center reads 'SEVEN SYMPTOMS' in orange. Radiating out from the central motif in a circular arrangement, seven small labeled icon-pairs (icon + label in caps below): BLOATING (puffed stomach icon), SULFUR BURPS (small cloud icon), CONSTIPATION (blocked-tube icon), BRICK FEELING (brick icon), PRESSURE (chest pressure icon), CRAMPS (lightning bolt over stomach), NAUSEA (queasy face icon). Connected by thin gray lines from each icon to the central cluster. Color palette: deep navy blue (#2c4a73) and warm orange (#e85a3a). Clean modern flat vector illustration style. White background. Match the style of a high-end medical wellness infographic.
